Comfortable Living Space: Shakespeare Central Apartment in Craiova offers a one-bedroom apartment with a living room and a balcony. The kitchen includes a coffee machine and a TV, while the bathroom features parquet floors.
Essential Facilities: Guests enjoy free WiFi and free off-site private parking. The apartment provides a sofa and a comfortable seating area, ensuring a pleasant stay.
Local Attractions: Ion Oblemeco Stadium is a 19-minute walk away, while Craiova International Airport lies 3.7 mi from the property. Boating opportunities enhance the surrounding area.
Couples in particular like the location – they rated it 10 for a two-person trip.
